worktree.setup: set -euo pipefail; mkdir -p .context; command -v codegraph >/dev/null || { echo 'codegraph is required for worktree setup' >&2; exit 1; }; if [ -d .codegraph ]; then codegraph sync .; else codegraph init .; fi; codegraph status

build.command: set -euo pipefail; mkdir -p .context/DerivedData; xcodebuild -project HangTen.xcodeproj -scheme HangTen -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' -derivedDataPath .context/DerivedData CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO CODE_SIGNING_REQUIRED=NO build

test.command: set -euo pipefail; : "${HANGTEN_SIMULATOR_UDID:?Set HANGTEN_SIMULATOR_UDID to a dedicated simulator UUID}"; mkdir -p .context/DerivedData; xcodebuild -project HangTen.xcodeproj -scheme HangTen -configuration Debug -destination "platform=iOS Simulator,id=${HANGTEN_SIMULATOR_UDID}" -parallel-testing-enabled NO -maximum-parallel-testing-workers 1 -derivedDataPath .context/DerivedData -resultBundlePath .context/HangTenTests.xcresult CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=YES CODE_SIGNING_REQUIRED=YES CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY=- test

title.instructions: Use a concise, descriptive title that names the user-visible change.

branchName.instructions: Use a short kebab-case branch name derived from the config update.

commitMessage.instructions: Use a Conventional Commit message that states the durable change.

pullRequest.instructions:
Always push new commits to the remote automatically
Monitor CI until it is green, fix failures at the root, and address actionable review comments before considering the PR complete.
